ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites for CI499 courses associated with PLTW include successful completion of one of the PLTW Summer Core Training Institutes during the summer of 2015 (see http://www.pltw.uillinois.edu for more information) or earlier. Participants must have ready access to the Internet, a valid, working email address, and access to a computer with multimedia capabilities. The coursework for this class extends and builds on summer institute professional development activity. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to students participating in the Project Lead The Way (PLTW) program.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $402.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
